biota.desc: Keystone litho-biotic organism native to Nyxora-Cradle, adapted to 1.62g gravity.
biota.lifecycle: Thrives within the 72% Nitrogen, 24% Oxygen, 4% Ionized Helium (1.3 bar) envelope of Nyxora-Cradle, forming vast bio-luminescent networks that stabilize planetary climate. Cultivated by the Nyxora Silicates as living architectural habitats and biological resonance sensors.

vista.title: THE SUB-GLACIAL HYDRO-ARCOLOGYS OF NYXORA-CRADLE
vista.desc: Built in the Sub-Glacial Hydro-Arcology style, the settlements of Nyxora-Cradle weave Zero-Point Nyxora Flux Siphon conduits into living landscapes. Illuminated by the warm glow of Epsilon 36756-A filtering through 72% Nitrogen, 24% Oxygen, 4% Ionized Helium (1.3 bar), where silent gravity gliders arc between the domes.

quote.text: Matter is condensed music; when technology honors the living biosphere, a planet shines like a star in the higher dimensions.
